sources.title: Carter-Black/handwriting-ai - GitHub
sources.snippet: The fine-tuning step only updates the last few decoder layers using the user's own samples — this takes minutes on a CPU and produces a personalized model saved entirely locally. The font pipeline doesn't use ML at all — it's pure computer vision (OpenCV segmentation + potrace vectorization).

sources.title: FontTrace — Free AI Image to Font Generator
sources.snippet: Free AI font generator — upload any image containing lettering and FontTrace will generate the full alphabet in that style and trace it into a free downloadable .ttf font.
